Set dark appearance for the Add channel phone capture

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.documentElement;root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top','0px');root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-bottom','0px');const top=getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-top').trim(),bottom=getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-bottom').trim();if(top!=='0px'||bottom!=='0px')throw new Error(`selected capture requires zero insets, got ${top}/${bottom}`);return {top,bottom,viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight}}})()

metadata.label: Match the selected artwork zero-inset capture while preserving separate safe-area verification
Open the channel picker without changing the saved order

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector("[data-testid=\"escalation-order-root\"]");const choices=document.querySelector("[data-testid=\"escalation-order-channel-picker\"]");const text=root?.textContent||"";const buttons=[...(choices?.querySelectorAll("button")||[])];const email=buttons.find(button=>button.textContent?.includes("Email"));if(!choices||buttons.length!==1||!email||!text.includes("Escalation order · Web Push selected")||!text.includes("Add a channel")||!text.includes("Append a supported channel to the order")||!text.includes("Availability is checked separately")||!text.includes("An adapter-ready observation does not prove a deliverable destination"))throw new Error(`Add channel state mismatch choices=${buttons.map(button=>button.textContent).join("|")} text=${text}`);return {availableChoices:["email"],selectedSavedChannel:"web_push",availabilityDisclosure:true,noOrderWriteBeforeCapture:true}})()

metadata.label: Verify Email is available, Web Push remains saved, and eligibility stays held

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.documentElement;root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top','0px');root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-right','0px');root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-bottom','0px');root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-left','0px');const insets=Object.fromEntries(['top','right','bottom','left'].map(key=>[key,getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-'+key).trim()]));const actualTheme=root.getAttribute('data-theme');if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||devicePixelRatio!==2||actualTheme!=='dark'||Object.values(insets).some(value=>value!=='0px'))throw new Error(`selected phone environment mismatch viewport=${innerWidth}x${innerHeight} dpr=${devicePixelRatio} theme=${actualTheme} insets=${JSON.stringify(insets)}`);return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},devicePixelRatio,theme:actualTheme,insets}})()
